 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani
 Order

By way of the present petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023, the petitioners, who are the former husband and in- laws of the complainant/respondent No.2, seek quashing of case FIR No.417/2017 dated 30.08.2017 registered under sections 498A/406 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S.: Pandav Nagar, East Delhi.

The petition was filed on 21.12.2024; and was thereafter listed before the learned Joint-Registrar for recording of statements of the parties in view of Practice Directions dated 24.12.2024, which have since been recalled.
Though respondent No.2 has signed Settlement Deed dated 01.12.2023; and the parties have also got a divorce by mutual consent vid decree dated 29.10.2024, however respondent No.2 has not appeared in the matter on the last 02 dates and her statement has not been recorded.
In view thereof, issue notice.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 13/02/2026 at 20:36:26 Mr. Sanjay Lao, learned Standing Counsel appears on behalf of the State on advance copy; and accepts notice.

sentences.text:
At this stage, respondent No.2, has joined the proceedings via video- conferencing, accepts notice;
and submits that she is not willing to concede to the quashing of the FIR in view of the change in circumstances.
Let reply be filed within 06 weeks; rejoinder thereto, if any, be filed within 04 weeks thereafter; with copies to the opposing counsel.
ANUP JAIRAM BHAMBHANI, J JANUARY 30, 2026 ds
